Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that requests speaker diarization for a recorded meeting using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import os
from azure.ai.speech import SpeechConfig, SpeechRecognizer, AudioConfig
from azure.ai.speech.speech import SpeakerRecognitionModel
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
from azure.ai.speech import SpeechSynthesizer

# Set up Azure Speech Services configuration
speech_config = SpeechConfig(subscription=os.getenv("AZURE_SPEECH_KEY"), region=os.getenv("AZURE_SPEECH_REGION"))
speech_config.speech_recognition_language = "en-US"

# Enable speaker diarization
speech_config.set_service_property("SpeakerDiarization", "true")

# Create audio configuration from file
audio_config = AudioConfig(filename="meeting_recording.wav")

# Create speech recognizer
recognizer = SpeechRecognizer(speech_config=speech_config, audio_config=audio_config)

# Start recognition
print("Recognizing speech with speaker diarization...")
result = recognizer.recognize_once()

if result.reason == "RecognizedSpeech":
    print(f"Recognized: {result.text}")
    # Parse diarization results from the recognition result
    if hasattr(result, 'speaker_diarization'):
        print("Speaker diarization results:")
        for speaker in result.speaker_diarization:
            print(f"Speaker {speaker.id}: {speaker.text}")
elif result.reason == "NoMatch":
    print("No speech could be recognized")
elif result.reason == "Canceled":
    cancellation_details = result.cancellation_details
    print(f"Speech was canceled: {cancellation_details.reason}")
    if cancellation_details.reason == "Error":
        print(f"Error details: {cancellation_details.error_details}")
```
